stories.title: In de slotfase begint het toch nog te lopen en weet Oranje een afgang tegen Griekenland te voorkomen

en.title: Netherlands avoids defeat against Greece in final stages
en.summary: The Dutch national team played poorly for much of the match against Greece but secured a 2-2 draw late in the game. Greece had surprised many by leading the group after two earlier victories.

stories.title: Vreselijke eerste helft Oranje tegen Griekenland, puik herstel na rust (2-2)

en.title: Terrible first half Netherlands against Greece, excellent recovery after halftime (2-2)
en.summary: The Netherlands had a poor first half but recovered well in the second half to draw 2-2 with Greece.

stories.title: Oranje knokt zich naar gelijkspel na beroerde eerste helft tegen Griekenland

en.title: Netherlands fights back to draw after terrible first half against Greece
en.summary: The Netherlands avoided its first loss under coach Xavi Hernández by recovering from a 2-0 halftime deficit to draw 2-2 with Greece in a Nations League match.

stories.title: Brits-Iraanse man opgepakt op verdenking van het voorbereiden van terreurdaden, na incident bij luchtvaartbasis Fairford

en.title: British-Iranian man arrested on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts following incident at Fairford air base
en.summary: British police arrested a suspect in connection with a security incident at a military base used by the United States. The British Prime Minister previously stated there were strong indications of Iranian involvement.

stories.title: Oranje begint met Til, Van Bommel en broers Timber tegen Griekenland

en.title: Netherlands starts with Til, Van Bommel and Timber brothers against Greece
en.summary: The Dutch team's starting lineup for the Nations League match in Thessaloniki includes Guus Til, Ruben van Bommel, and brothers Jurriën and Quinten Timber. Gravenberch and Reijnders are on the bench.

stories.title: Zeven keer Paulien Cornelisse op haar scherpst: ‘Wat mensen anders maakt dan dieren is dat ze elkaar willen verbeteren’

en.title: Seven times Paulien Cornelisse at her sharpest: 'What makes people different from animals is that they want to improve each other'
en.summary: An archive selection highlights notable moments from the career of writer, cabaret performer and broadcaster Paulien Cornelisse, known for her ability to magnify the small and diminish the large.

stories.title: Brits-Iraanse man opgepakt om incident rond Britse luchtmachtbasis

en.title: British-Iranian man arrested over incident at British air force base
en.summary: A 27-year-old dual British-Iranian national was arrested in London on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts related to Fairford air force base. Two properties were searched and a 26-year-old was questioned, following an earlier incident that led to five arrests.

stories.title: Brits-Iraanse man opgepakt voor voorbereiden van aanslag bij vliegbasis

en.title: British-Iranian man arrested for preparing attack at air base
en.summary: A British counterterrorism unit arrested a dual national following a weekend incident at Fairford air base where five people were initially detained for suspicious activities and later released on bail.

stories.title: Vakgenoten over Paulien Cornelisse: ‘Haar manier van kijken is niet in één woord te vangen, ‘Paulinisme’ komt het dichtst in de buurt’

en.title: Colleagues on Paulien Cornelisse: 'Her way of looking at things cannot be captured in one word, "Paulinism" comes closest'
en.summary: Writer and cabaret performer Paulien Cornelisse died on Wednesday. Colleagues describe her distinctive perspective and approach to language and performance as difficult to summarize in a single term.

stories.title: Paulien Cornelisse was geen schoolmeester, haar plezier in taal was de sleutel tot haar succes

en.title: Paulien Cornelisse was no schoolteacher, her pleasure in language was the key to her success
en.summary: Paulien Cornelisse achieved success through her genuine enjoyment of language rather than through didactic or instructional approach.

stories.title: Als cabaretier trok Paulien Cornelisse het publiek moeiteloos haar unieke gedachtewereld in

en.title: As a cabaret performer, Paulien Cornelisse effortlessly drew audiences into her unique world of thought
en.summary: Paulien Cornelisse was a cabaret performer known for captivating audiences with her distinctive creative perspective.

stories.title: Radio- en theatermaker Chris Bajema, de man van Paulien Cornelisse, schreef voor haar een 150

en.title: Radio and theater maker Chris Bajema, the partner of Paulien Cornelisse, wrote a 150 for her
en.summary: Chris Bajema, a radio and theater creator and partner of Paulien Cornelisse, composed a work of 150 units for her.
